source_label: Associação Nacional de Livrarias (ANL) — Associados + Anuário lane
source_class: member-grade; national-association; paid/controlled national directory adjunct
entity_role_primary: bookstore/member; mixed publisher/distributor/editorial roles require classification
observed_strength: Public associates page is directly crawlable; official ANL source; national Anuário has richer but access-controlled PDF/Excel
observed_count_claim: No global member count promoted from public associates page; visible page has sequential linked entries through at least 64. ANL 2023 Anuário is a national cataloguing product, but not public bulk data.
visible_fields: member/display name; external website link; street/address fragments; city/state; phone; sometimes CEP; logo/image
extraction_posture: Crawl public associates HTML; parse headings/link URLs/address/phone; keep staged role classifier. Do not scrape/paywall the paid Anuário; record it as controlled enrichment surface.
promotion_rule: Promote only rows classified as bookstore/bookstore-chain/bookstore-cafe/location; keep publishers/distributors/editorials as book-trade organization rows unless storefront evidence exists.
qa_notes: ANL associates page includes bookstores plus publishers/distributors/editors/events; row-level role classification is mandatory.

source_label: Camino a Frankfurt 2027 / Ministerio de las Culturas — Directorio de contactos, Librerías
source_class: official/quasi-official ecosystem directory; downloadable Google Sheet candidate
entity_role_primary: bookstore/contact directory, but sheet/tab must be resolved before row promotion
observed_strength: Official Frankfurt 2027 culture-ministry surface lists downloadable contact directories for editoriales, distribuidoras, and librerías.
observed_count_claim: No row count promoted; Google Sheet rendered as view-only JS shell in this runtime with rows 1–100 visible but no content extracted.
visible_fields: directory category link; Google Sheet ID; probable tabbed contact workbook; fields unknown until export is available
extraction_posture: Use Google Sheets export/gviz in networked runtime; identify correct Librerías tab; save raw CSV/XLSX; hash; then normalize.
promotion_rule: Do not treat the Google Sheet shell as harvested data; promote only after exportable rows confirm bookstore identity and fields.
qa_notes: Parsed page maps the three 'Descargue contactos aquí' labels to one visible Google Sheets link in this runtime; tab disambiguation is required.

source_label: Cámara Peruana del Libro — Directorio asociados
source_class: member-grade; official chamber directory; mixed book-trade roles
entity_role_primary: member organization; bookstore candidates among publishers/distributors/educational bodies
observed_strength: Public directory is large static HTML with member blocks; CPL description confirms it includes publishers, university presses, distributors, booksellers, installment-sales organizations, research/documentation centers, promotion entities, and book clubs.
observed_count_claim: FIL Lima organizer page states CPL has more than 130 members; no bookstore-only count promoted.
visible_fields: member name; address; representative/cargo/sector/especialidad labels (often blank); phone; website link
extraction_posture: Parse all directory blocks from public HTML; stage all as CPL_member; classify bookstore vs non-bookstore using name/website/role signals.
promotion_rule: Only promote rows with bookstore/business-store evidence or explicit Librería name/role; keep remaining members as book-trade organization rows.
qa_notes: Directory includes blank sector/specialty fields and many non-bookstore organizations; role classification is the core QA task.

source_class: member-grade; chamber member roster with explicit category flags
observed_strength: Public Socios page separates General, Librerías, Editoriales, Distribuidoras and renders category labels plus member names.
observed_count_claim: No single promoted bookstore count; visible Librerías section includes approximately 29 bookstore-category entries in this runtime, but full page has duplicated general/category blocks.
visible_fields: category label; member name; image/logo; sometimes link if image/detail target present
extraction_posture: Parse category blocks; prefer dedicated Librerías section over General duplicates; dedupe member names; stage publishers/distributors separately.
promotion_rule: Promote Librería category rows as bookstore-candidate/member rows; do not promote General block duplicates twice.
qa_notes: The page repeats members across General and category sections; dedupe and section-awareness are mandatory.

source_label: Cámara Costarricense del Libro — Asociados Activos
source_class: member-grade; chamber active-member roster; mixed book-trade and author/editor rows
entity_role_primary: active member; bookstore candidates among editorial/distributor/author/association rows
observed_strength: Active-members page is static and exposes names, contacts, emails, websites; official chamber site; CCL mission/identity page confirms broad book-chain remit.
observed_count_claim: No bookstore count promoted; page visibly lists active associates with images 13–50 but includes many non-bookstore roles.
visible_fields: member name; contact person; email; website/social link; occasional role words such as Autor, Escritor y Editor, Librería Internacional
extraction_posture: Parse all member blocks; classify direct bookstore candidates (Librería Internacional, Everything Faith Bookstore, El Librero Pandeado, Librería Lehmann) separately from publishers/authors/associations.
promotion_rule: Promote only bookstore/store candidates after manual/automated role signal review; keep the rest as book-trade chamber members.
qa_notes: Strong for chamber ecosystem mapping, weak as a bookstore-only registry without role filtering.
